scope: Synthetic timestamp-led photo retrieval; no source library access or public photo additions
change: Replace prose-only temporal safeguards with a pure capture-time classifier and behavioral regressions while preserving all existing photo gates.

red.reason: The required classifier was absent; each behavior first failed the missing-function assertion.

followupRegression.reason: Protect the capture-date boundary for later photographs of documents and for imports occurring after capture.
followupRegression.testFirstObservation: Both added characterization cases passed existing behavior on their first execution; no new failing-to-passing implementation claim is made.
followupRegression.boundary: A photo capture interval cannot establish the date of an underlying document or event; a later import cannot move the capture instant.

permissionReceipt.explanation: The existing helper independently compared the frozen base checkout and current binding-relevant records. This preserves prior verification for an unchanged approved derivative; it is not fresh source-library verification.

fullCheck.firstAttempt: Sandbox denied local loopback listeners; rerun with permitted loopback access passed the 40 public-language tests.
fullCheck.resolution: Fresh independent exact-candidate reviews are required. No prior scorecard was relabeled.

limits: An explicit offset is supplied evidence, not validation of an IANA time zone or a camera clock.
Temporal overlap yields only a candidate requiring visual review.
Identity, event membership, captions and publication rights are never established by this classifier.
Synthetic passing cases do not establish source-library coverage or human approval.
Full portfolio readiness and exact-candidate hosted checks remain separate; the prior professor-lens hold is not cleared here.
